caption: The video captures a winter landscape where a snow-covered field with faint tracks lies before a dense line of dark pine trees under a pale overcast sky. Near the right side of the tree line, a large billowing white cloud of disturbed snow sits low to the ground and occupies much of the right side. This cloud continues to grow, its upper boundary rising and its volume expanding. It stays anchored near the trees rather than drifting across the field. Countless bright particles are ejected upward and outward, forming a spray that broadens and thins as it moves toward the upper left. The cloud's silhouette deforms as it billows, with lobes merging and its top edge becoming taller and more diffuse. The background remains broadly stable, with no obvious camera movement, and the disturbance continues.
